msme_payment_rule.value: Pay micro and small suppliers within 15 days if there is no written agreement, and within 45 days at most if there is one. Rule: Income-tax Act 1961 s.43B(h), now s.37(2)(g) of the Income-tax Act 2025. Complaints can be filed on odr.msme.gov.in (since 15 October 2025).
